demo.program:
# Clojure — self-test quiz demo
qa = [
    ("Who created Clojure?", "Rich Hickey"),
    ("What paradigm is Clojure?", "functional"),
    ("What is creator?", "Rich Hickey"),
    ("What is first appeared?", "2007"),
    ("What is paradigm?", "functional"),
    ("What is typing?", "dynamic"),
    ("What is file extension?", ".clj"),
    ("What is hello world?", "(println \"Hello, world!\")"),
]
score = 0
for i, (q, a) in enumerate(qa, 1):
    print(f"Q{i}: {q}")
    ans = input("Your answer: ").strip().lower()
    if ans and ans in a.lower():
        print("Correct.")
        score += 1
    else:
        print(f"Answer: {a}")
print(f"Score: {score}/{len(qa)}")
